_doc: Item 7 routing table (staged 10-29; search_route.py reads it). Off by default: with enabled=false every search gets profile 'fallback' (today's patch 0005: Exa then Tavily when SearXNG + free sources bring < 5 results). A run picks a profile with "route" in run/paid-run.json, or PAID_ROUTE_PROFILE. free = asked on every search of the tag; paid = asked on every search of the tag, in order, until one returns results; fallback = asked in order only when fewer than fallback_below results came so far. Paid sources always go through paid_budget's caps. Cache: paid results only, TTL per tag (ttl_hours), empty results at most empty_ttl_hours. 11-03 (item 7d, staged): a profile's "_select" asks its paid / fallback sources only on the run's follow-up searches (search_route.select_step: after the lead's first search once subagents have reported, at least follow_after_s into the run, or from search late+1; then per_sub per subagent and per_lead for the lead; skip_unknown searches without an agent label first). 7d = Tavily on the follow-up searches; 7dx = the same, but Exa instead of Tavily for product-tagged ones (Karl 11-03: Exa for product-type searches only, a test arm).
